privacy_rules: Never capture passwords, bearer tokens, JWTs, refresh tokens, provider secrets or authorization headers.
Use Account A / Account B aliases instead of raw account identifiers in screenshots, HARs and notes.
Redact profile payloads, workflow notes and confidential company state unless a minimal synthetic value is necessary for the test.
If correlation_id exists, it must be opaque and safe to share with support; otherwise record UNKNOWN rather than inventing one.

go_no_go.GO: All required config requirements and required journey rows PASS on the same exact deployed canonical build, with no conditional skip and no tenant/privacy leak. This is #68 operational browser GO only, not release/commercial GO.
go_no_go.NO_GO: Any required FAIL, UNKNOWN, BLOCKED_EXTERNAL, conditional skip, exact-build mismatch, tenant leak, unsafe evidence capture or untruthful degraded/empty state.
